name: get_rolling_release
description:
Return the Rolling Release for a project, regardless of whether the rollout is active, aborted, or completed. If the feature is enabled but no deployment has occurred yet, null will be returned.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
